sourceNotes.rawContent:
Description:
Add a graceful touch to your ethnic style with these olive green glass bangles, beautifully embellished with sparkling stones. Ideal for festive occasions, weddings, or daily wear, these bangles pair perfectly with both traditional and modern outfits.
-
Material: Premium Glass
-
Work: Stone-studded floral design
-
Color: Olive Green (with golden sheen)
-
Design: Elegant glossy finish with stone embellishment
-
Size/ Fit: Available in multiple sizes (2.4, 2.6, 2.8, etc.)
-
Occasion: Suitable for weddings, festivals, parties & daily wear
-
Care Instruction: Handle with care as these are glass bangles
Crafted from premium-quality glass, this bangle set reflects authentic Indian craftsmanship while offering a comfortable fit for all-day wear. olive green glass bangle shade pairs beautifully with sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, and Indo-western outfits, making it a versatile accessory for any festive look.
Key Features:
-
Premium-quality glass with durable finish
-
Mustard yellow color with stone embellishments
-
Lightweight and comfortable for extended wear
-
Perfect for weddings, festive occasions, and gifting
-
Available in multiple sizes for the perfect fit

notes: source text states color inconsistently: spec list says 'Olive Green (with golden sheen)' but Key Features says 'Mustard yellow color' — used Olive Green as primary since referenceTitle also says 'Olive Green'; flagging the discrepancy for owner review.
